note: Matte game palette of the tool world models (toolgen/game_export.py). 'materials' are the palette materials. Non-glow entries are matte variants (<Cube Escape name>_Matte, ce_base = the Cube Escape material) - Cube Escape's same-name materials are glossier; like the matte player robot (Robogen 1.20 finish 'Standard' = matt, gloss only as 'Lack') the import creates these variants instead of reusing the glossy ones. Glow materials keep their Cube Escape names and emission; M_GlowWarm (warm white flashlight lens) is new. 'map' assigns every source material (generator prefix + name) to one palette material and must stay complete.
